content.text:
Boolean flags with secondary opts now show the `default_map` value in `--help`. With your `{"long": True}` example, the help prints `[default: long]` instead of `[default: short]`. I ran that case after the change. I didn't run the test suite or add a test.

The fix is one line in `src/click/core.py`. The help code already looks up the resolved default (including `default_map`) but ignored it for these flags, so it now uses that value.

I also added an entry to `CHANGES.rst`. I used `:issue:`2723`` as the issue number, which is my guess, so please check it.
